core_claim: When a million English-speaking xkcd readers each see a different RGB patch and type one of five color words, the resulting naming map is overwhelmingly settled — but the small slivers where it isn't reveal exactly how language, biology, and the screen each shape what we see.

edt_01.label: Hook — A million people, one of five words
edt_01.title: A million people, one of five words
edt_01.editorial_notes: 1,058,211 and 152,401 must appear exactly. Set up the constraint: the answers are filtered to top-5 names only.

edt_02.label: How a name carves out a region of color space
edt_02.title: How a name carves out a region of color space
edt_02.editorial_notes: Hue ranges (8-91, 74-158, 178-257, 252-327, 15-352) must appear; Designer should aim for a hue-wheel chart with stacked area or smooth band per name.

edt_03.label: Most of the cube is settled
edt_03.title: Most of the cube is settled
edt_03.editorial_notes: 88.6% mean / 95.8% median winner share are the headline. The 1,473/1,473 perfect green agreement is the emotional anchor.

edt_04.label: The boundaries — where naming breaks down
edt_04.title: The boundaries — where naming breaks down
edt_04.editorial_notes: Mid-grey (#606060) split must appear (33.9% purple, 25% brown, 23.2% blue). Pink-purple crossover at hue ~310° is the resolution to the famous fuchsia-vs-magenta debate.

edt_05.label: Two X chromosomes name color slightly differently
edt_05.title: Two X chromosomes name color slightly differently
edt_05.editorial_notes: Numbers: blue +2.17 pp XX, green -1.14 pp, divergence 0.04 mean. Always include the spam confound (81.5% XY in spam_prob>0.75).

edt_06.label: The colorblind fingerprint
edt_06.title: The colorblind fingerprint
edt_06.editorial_notes: Purple -5.94, pink +3.36, green +2.62 must be exact. The 0.117 vs 0.04 cell divergence is the surprise: colorblindness shifts naming nearly 3x more than chromosome. Cite specific cell #b5a0ca with both percentages. 4.6x vs 16x population benchmark must appear.

edt_07.label: A small but visible monitor effect
edt_07.title: A small but visible monitor effect
edt_07.editorial_notes: 95.8% LCD vs 3.9% CRT split. Pink swing -2.29 pp on CRT. Keep brief — third-tier effect.

edt_08.label: A vocabulary, not a list
edt_08.title: A vocabulary, not a list
edt_08.editorial_notes: 72.5% multi-word names is the central fact. green 170 vs blue 110 head counts must appear. Cultural afterlife matters (matplotlib xkcd: namespace).

edt_09.label: Closing — what 1,473 people called green
edt_09.title: What 1,473 people called green
edt_09.editorial_notes: The 1473/1473 number is the closing punch. Contrast with the 56-person, 5-word #606060 story. End on the conceptual claim: settled territory is the foundation against which boundary disagreements show up.
